 W Tim Robinson lbw b Auqib Nabi
 Auqib Nabi to Tim Robinson, out Lbw!! Another one bites the dust. Auqib Nabi has taken two in two, and he will be on a hat-trick, but I doubt he will be able to bowl another over with only 4 minutes remaining today. This was a length delivery that kept really low, and Tim Robinson got beaten and pinned on the pads. The lack of bounce does him, and up goes the umpire's finger. That looked plumb. India A pulling things back after a solid start by the New Zealand A openers. They have now lost three wickets in quick succession. How the tide has turned within a matter of minutes!
